task_info.problem_statement:
# AW burst of length N clears N+1 addresses

When an AW burst of length N with start address A is sent to the axi_riscv_lrsc module, it submits a check+clear request for addresses [A, A+N], but the correct range would be [A,  A+(N-1)].

Probably it would be sufficient to change [line 761](https://github.com/pulp-platform/axi_riscv_atomics/blob/c3c3f2b65071841035c4e081c61c9b7be801d749/src/axi_riscv_lrsc.sv#L761) from:
```verilog
if (aw_res_len > 1) begin
    clr_len_d  = aw_res_len - 1;
```
to:
```verilog
if (aw_res_len > 1) begin
    clr_len_d  = aw_res_len - 2;
```
